answer: In PoA, trust propagates as a bounded-length random walk on the attestation graph: transition mass reaching a candidate is discounted by path probability and capped by the walk horizon. A sybil cluster resembles a knoll isolated from the river of honest attestations; its sparse external cut has low conductance, so min-cut transitivity bounds escape flow and thus aggregate voting weight. Even a whisper of collusion cannot amplify it beyond boundary capacity.
